description: Implementation of MessageControl class handling message control operations, threading, and client communication within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: MessageControlImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing message control interface, managing message dispatch, client communication, and threading.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Core::Thread to run message dispatch loop.

classes.name: MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class for loading and providing message configuration settings.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets or replaces the callback for message collection, manages thread state accordingly.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Adds an instance ID to the message client.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Removes an instance ID from the message client.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables message categories/modules based on parameters.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves current message control settings as an iterator.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Internal method to wait for message updates and invoke callback with message data.
